initialObservations.source: Single straight eight-sided pale pillar on square beveled foot. Moss is seven little uniformly beveled blocks. One narrow front crack does not articulate the shaft. Source is very bright on top and cyan-gray on lower planes.
initialObservations.target: Cream ivory broken masonry with broad rounded edge bands, softer stepping at the broken top, pale warm/cool plane variation, descending moss patches and real irregular fractures joining larger stone masses. Base is worn squared plinth with stones settling into the foot.
initialObservations.nativeApproach: Rebuild the pillar as several joined irregular beveled stone masses, retain overall narrow vertical role on square footing, add rounded native moss patches around all sides, tiny native stone weathering relief and broad symmetric lighting. Keep purposeful relief rather than a paint-over.
